parsed.draft_response:
Hi there — sorry about the disruption for your new analyst. We can help investigate this and get her access working.

To move this forward today, could you please reply with the following:
1) The exact “access denied” message text (or a screenshot) and where it appears (e.g., on the workspace page vs. after login).
2) The workspace name (and workspace ID if you have it), and whether she’s trying to access production or staging.
3) The email address of the invited analyst.
4) The role/permission that was assigned to her when the invite was created.
5) Confirmation whether she can log into the account at all, or only fails when opening the specific workspace.

Once we have that, we’ll escalate to our support team to review the invite/account provisioning and workspace permissions for her account and work with you to restore access as quickly as possible.
promised_actions: Escalate to our support team to review the invite/account provisioning and workspace permissions for the invited analyst
Work with you to restore access as quickly as possible
safety_notes: User requested help today; classification indicates human review is needed. Response avoids promising a specific fix, refund, or confirmed root cause/SLA.
Additional details are required to disambiguate whether the failure is login-level vs workspace-permission-level and which environment/workspace is affected.

parsed.customer_impact: The newly invited analyst is blocked from accessing the workspace, preventing them from performing their work; this is an operational disruption and may delay analyst activities.

Other users can log in normally.
missing_information: What exact error message is shown (full text or screenshot) and where it appears.
Which workspace/app environment (name/ID, production vs. staging) the analyst is trying to access.
Whether the analyst’s account was fully provisioned/created successfully after the invite.
What role/permissions were assigned to the invited analyst in the workspace.
Whether the analyst can log in to the account at all or only fails when opening the workspace.
Any timestamps of when the invite was accepted and when access was attempted.
Whether other newly invited users have the same problem or this is isolated to one analyst.
risk_signals: An access denied error after invite acceptance indicates a potential misconfiguration or permission issue affecting account/workspace access.
parsed.summary: After accepting an invitation, a newly added analyst receives an “access denied” message and cannot access the workspace, while other users can log in normally.
